question: Estimate the total flower demand during India's wedding season (Nov-Feb).
idealClarificationQuestions: Cut flowers + garland + petals + decoration? Yes — all weddings only.
Indian wedding season Nov-Feb (~4 months) and post-monsoon Apr-Jun? Use 4-month main season.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Number of weddings in season × flower per wedding.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~2-2.5 lakh tonnes of flower demand during wedding season.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~237 million kg = ~2.4 lakh tonnes in 4 months.
~2-2.5 lakh tonnes of flower demand during wedding season.

calculationFlow: Of which during peak season (Nov-Feb): ~50% = ~5-6M weddings.
- Affluent (10%): 200 kg/wedding (decoration heavy) = 600K wed × 200 = 120 million kg.
Subtotal: ~237 million kg = ~2.4 lakh tonnes in 4 months.
Round: ~2-2.5 lakh tonnes of flower demand during wedding season.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~2-2.5 lakh tonnes of flower demand during wedding season.
